content.text:
The site changed because the web font stopped loading, and I've fixed it.

**Cause:** In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The directory is `site/fonts/`, so the request returned 404. Every page uses `--font-sans`, so all six fell back to the system font.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. The font now loads (HTTP 200, `font/woff2`), and all 16 functional tests pass. I didn't compare screenshots.

**Limits:** The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the typo. I found it by reading the CSS. No other `url()` references exist in the stylesheets. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
